notes.title: Yōso Warriors Multiplayer Beta Update Now Live
notes.content: Hello Everyone! Thank you again for your patience. The multiplayer update for Yōso Warriors is now live and ready to play. As always, we would love to hear your feedback so that we may improve the quality of the game. You can provide us with your feedback on our website under Contact Us, or in the discussions section of our Community Hub on our Steam page. A link to our website can be found on our store page. We look forward to continuing our service to you and providing more content for Yōso Warriors.

notes.title: Version 0.8.1 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added online multiplayer mode
[list]
[*] Search online for an open match or host your own
[*] Invite your friends to play with you in an online match
[*] Earn rewards in online matches
[/list]
[*] Modified some minor graphics to help improve game visuals
[/list]

notes.title: Yōso Warriors Multiplayer Beta Update Coming Soon
notes.content: Hello Everyone! Thank you very much for your patience. We are almost done with the Multiplayer Beta Update for Yōso Warriors. The update will be live by the end of this week for the public. As you are aware, Yōso Warriors is still in its beta testing phase and we would love to hear any feedback that you may have with regards to the gameplay, layout, bugs, and anything else you would like to share. Please share any feedback you may have on our website under Contact Us, or in the discussions section of our Community Hub on our Steam page. A link to our website can be found on our store page.

notes.title: Yōso Warriors Multiplayer Status Update
notes.content: Hello Everyone! Our programmer had to undergo surgery last week which will result in a delay in our development while our programmer recovers. We are currently working on the development of the Yōso Warriors multiplayer update. Our goal is to have the multiplayer update ready for a beta release by the end of the calendar year. We will continue to provide updates to our community as we continue to make progress.
